# itch adapter example

```python
# Not autogenerated.
"""Map NASDAQ ITCH 5.0 messages to order-book operations."""

from lobo.replay.adapters import CustomAdapter, Protocol
from lobo.replay.adapters import expressions as le
from lobo.replay.adapters import models as lm


def protocol() -> Protocol:
    # The ITCH stock-locate number routes records to their instrument.
    register = lm.Register(
        symbol=le.Field("symbol"),
        key=le.Variable("key"),
        price_decimals=4,
        quantity_decimals=0,
    )
    # Offsets are bytes from the message tag, after the two-byte length prefix.
    # Every order message starts with an 11-byte header.
    add_fields = {
        "id": lm.UInt(11, 8),
        "side": lm.Text(19, 1),
        "quantity": lm.UInt(20, 4),
        "symbol": lm.Text(24, 8),
        "price": lm.UInt(32, 4),
    }
    add = lm.Add(
        id=le.Field("id"),
        side=le.Field("side").map({"B": "buy", "S": "sell"}),
        price=le.Field("price"),
        quantity=le.Field("quantity"),
    )
    reduction = {"id": lm.UInt(11, 8), "quantity": lm.UInt(19, 4)}
    return Protocol(
        lm.Binary(
            length=lm.UInt(0, 2),  # Big-endian message length, excluding this prefix.
            tag=lm.UInt(0, 1),
            key=lm.UInt(1, 2),
            timestamp=lm.UInt(
                5, 6
            ),  # Nanoseconds since midnight in the source session.
            records={
                # System event, stock directory, add, execute, cancel, delete, replace.
                "S": lm.Record(
                    size=12,
                    fields={"event": lm.Text(11, 1)},
                    actions=(
                        le.When(le.Field("event").eq("S"), lm.DirectoryComplete()),
                    ),
                ),
                "R": lm.Record(
                    size=39, fields={"symbol": lm.Text(11, 8)}, actions=(register,)
                ),
                "A": lm.Record(size=36, fields=add_fields, actions=(register, add)),
                # F adds an attribution field; its order fields match A.
                "F": lm.Record(size=40, fields=add_fields, actions=(register, add)),
                "E": lm.Record(
                    size=31,
                    fields=reduction,
                    actions=(
                        lm.Execute(id=le.Field("id"), quantity=le.Field("quantity")),
                    ),
                ),
                "C": lm.Record(
                    size=36,
                    fields={**reduction, "price": lm.UInt(32, 4)},
                    actions=(
                        lm.Execute(
                            id=le.Field("id"),
                            quantity=le.Field("quantity"),
                            price=le.Field("price"),
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
                "X": lm.Record(
                    size=23,
                    fields=reduction,
                    actions=(
                        lm.Cancel(id=le.Field("id"), quantity=le.Field("quantity")),
                    ),
                ),
                "D": lm.Record(
                    size=19,
                    fields={"id": lm.UInt(11, 8)},
                    actions=(lm.Remove(id=le.Field("id")),),
                ),
                "U": lm.Record(
                    size=35,
                    fields={
                        "id": lm.UInt(11, 8),
                        "new_id": lm.UInt(19, 8),
                        "quantity": lm.UInt(27, 4),
                        "price": lm.UInt(31, 4),
                    },
                    actions=(
                        lm.Replace(
                            id=le.Field("id"),
                            new_id=le.Field("new_id"),
                            quantity=le.Field("quantity"),
                            price=le.Field("price"),
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
            },
        )
    )


def build_adapter(
    source: lm.Source, *, symbol: str = "AAPL", scope: list[str] | None = None
) -> CustomAdapter:
    return CustomAdapter(
        protocol(),
        source,
        name="NASDAQ ITCH 5.0",
        mode=lm.FeedMode.Replay,
        level=lm.BookLevel.L3,
        symbol=symbol,
        scope=scope,
        timezone="America/New_York",
    )
```
